title: The Letter I Did Not Send
text:
I kept your letter beneath a plate,

title: Final Arguments
text: In her final argument, counsel distinguished the disputed penalty from the admitted delay. She asked the court to evaluate the documents and conduct together, and to recognize the buyer's demonstrated loss. Across the room, the buyer's counsel defended the earlier schedule. Neither argument could restore the trust that hurried meetings and incomplete records had already damaged.

text: The judge concluded that the parties had adopted the revised schedule through their documented conduct. text: Back at the workshop, she changed the contract examination process. Revised pages would carry clear dates; approval would be recorded before work began.
